_what: Seven Days to the Wolves — director's cut megacut. The running order is the owner's, given this session; the shape of it comes from buildDirectorsCutVideoSequence() in ~/src/website/src/data/wolves-intro-sequence.ts, where the Destiny hero video sits after the prologue and before wolves.
_audio: Segments 2-4 carry their deliverable's own 48 kHz 5.1 audio, unprocessed. The hero segment and all four cards are silent by owner decision — Bungie's audio was never fetched. A bed under them is a licensing decision.

_sources.hero: renders/megacut-01-hero.mp4 — YouTube BKm0TPqeOjY, 'Destiny 2: Into the Light Cinematic', official 'Destiny 2' channel. Trimmed 2.0 -> 113.55 (both frame-verified against this file), video-only, six Guardian plates burned. usage_class: third_party_copyrighted.
